PLANNING COMMISSION
PLANNING COMMISSION
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday MARCH 9, 2017
07:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. Call to Order
2. Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag
3. Roll Call: Chair Nemeth Vice Chair Eneix
Commissioners French and Ward
4. Review of Agenda
5. Motion to Waive Full Reading of all Resolutions on the Agenda for this Meeting
6. Public Comments on Consent Calendar Items and any Items not on the Agenda
7. Consent Calendar Approval of Minutes from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of February 9, 2017
Minutes
8. Public Hearings OLD BUSINESS:
8A. General Plan Amendment (GPA) 16-002, Zone Change (ZC) 16-002, and Zoning Ordinance Amendment (ZOA) 16-002
Palmdale Aerospace Academy, Applicant
General Plan Amendment 16-002 is a request to amend the General Plan Land Use designation on 15.99 acres from MFR (Multi-Family Residential 10.1-16 du/ac) to CC (Community Commercial); Zone Change 16-002 is a request to change the zone designation on 15.99 acres from R-3 (Multiple Residential) to C-3 (General Commercial); and Zoning Ordinance Amendment 16-002 is a request to amend the Palmdale Municipal Code to allow schools from kindergarten through grade 12 within the C-3 (General Commercial) zone subject to approval of a Conditional Use Permit for the area at the southwest corner of Palmdale Boulevard and 35th Street East.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-007 recommending the City Council approve General Plan Amendment 16-002, Zone Change 16-002, and Zoning Ordinance Amendment 16-002; and adopt the Negative Declaration prepared for the proposed project. NEW BUSINESS: Victor Mendez, Assistant Planner
8A
8B. Tentative Tract Map (TTM) 62333 Time Extension (TE) No. 1
Unity Investors, LLC, Applicant
A request for a three-year time extension to develop approximately 7 acres into 22 single-family residential lots and one detention basin lot between Avenue R and Avenue R-4, approximately 100 feet east of Cardiff Street.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission take the following actions: adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-010 approving TTM 62333 No. 1 and find that the project will not result in any changes to the Mitigated Negative Declaration adopted for TTM 62333 on December 7, 2006. Victor Mendez, Assistant Planner
8B
8C. Conditional Use Permit (CUP) 17-001
Adamshak, Inc., Applicant
A request to establish a Type 41 Alcoholic Beverage Control license (on-sale beer and wine) in a bona fide restaurant (Dog Haus) located at 1301 West Rancho Vista Boulevard, Unit H.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-011 approving alcoholic beverage sales (Type 41, on-sale beer and wine) within a bona fide restaurant (Dog Haus), and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. It is also recommended that the Planning Commission review the data and make a determination as to whether public convenience or necessity will be served by the use. Victor Mendez, Assistant Planner
8C
8D. Zoning Ordinance Amendment 17-001
City of Palmdale, Applicant
A request to update Zoning Ordinance 95.05 to include Wireless Telecommunication Facilities.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission take the following actions: adopt Resolution No. PC 2017-012 recommending the City Council approve Zoning Ordinance Amendment 17-001, find that the proposed project will not result in a significant impact on the environment, and adopt the associated Mitigated Negative Declaration. Carlene Saxton, Senior Planner
8D
9. Staff Communications Development Update
Rob Bruce, Planning Manager
10. Planning Commission Communications
11. Adjournment to the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of Thursday, April 13, 2017, at 7:00 p.m., in the City of Palmdale City Hall Council Chamber
